predicted_goal_margin.rationale: Argentina's defensive solidity, having conceded only one goal in the tournament, combined with their championship experience, suggests a controlled win by a small margin.

probability_calibration.confidence_rationale: Confidence is set at 0.72 based on the strong alignment between betting markets (Argentina as favorite) and Opta's model, though tempered by Colombia's historic unbeaten streak.
probability_calibration.range_rationale: The range is anchored to the Opta model (50.4% for 90 mins) and FanDuel's implied market price (47.6%), resulting in a narrow window around 49%.

justification.claim: Argentina is the defending Copa America and reigning World Cup champion, possessing a core of experienced players from recent title cycles.
Opta's model predicts Argentina winning in 90 minutes 50.4% of the time, and betting markets list them as the favorite.
Argentina has a strong head-to-head record in Copa America knockout stages, remaining unbeaten against Colombia in five such meetings.

uncertainty.factor: Colombia's 28-game unbeaten streak, the longest in its national-team history.
The high creative influence of James Rodriguez, who broke the tournament assist record.

evidence.claim: Argentina conceded only one goal throughout the 2024 Copa America.
Colombia reached the final by defeating Uruguay 1-0, showing defensive resilience with 10 men.
Argentina's last encounter with Colombia resulted in an Argentine victory in February 2022.
